name: 402cron
description: Signed, verified HTTP delivery on a cron schedule. No account, no card, no human. We guarantee that we tried to deliver your task; we never pretend we can guarantee what someone else's server does with it. You pay per delivery attempt, not per outcome. You need your own public https:// endpoint that can echo a one-time verification challenge.
